description: Pin the load-bearing strict-int guard in parseIntField with a non-digit-content unit test case.

userStories.title: Pin strict-int guard with lenient-parseInt trap case
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need a unit test driving the exact non-digit field '12abc' so that the load-bearing /^-?\d+$/ guard in parseIntField is verifiably pinned against a regression to bare Number.parseInt.
acceptanceCriteria: test/tmux-display-message.test.ts adds a sampleCursorGeometry case feeding '12abc;5;80;24' (the lenient-parseInt trap the /^-?\d+$/ guard exists to defeat), asserting the result is null (fail-closed), placed in the existing 'fails CLOSED on malformed output' describe block and mirroring the '12;;80;24' block shape. [oracle: file-assert grep -q '12abc;5;80;24' test/tmux-display-message.test.ts]

The new case is falsifiable, not a tautology: it would go RED if parseIntField were loosened to a bare Number.parseInt (parseInt('12abc')===12 would let all four fields parse and yield a fabricated CursorGeometry instead of null). No existing case is refactored. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test), including the full test/tmux-display-message.test.ts suite with the new case green. [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Test-file-only change. Edit ONLY test/tmux-display-message.test.ts; do NOT touch src/tmux/display-message.ts (guard at lines 84-88 already returns null for '12abc' on main, verified manually per issue). Add exactly ONE case: fakeSpawn('12abc;5;80;24', 0) then expect(sampleCursorGeometry('%3', spawnFn)).toBeNull(), inside the existing describe('sampleCursorGeometry: fails CLOSED on malformed output') block, mirroring the existing '12;;80;24' case (test line ~78). This is a COVERAGE GAP not a live defect: only the test's presence flips red->green. test/*.ts is not in the compiled binary, so NO build-release/sidecar restart or coherence rebuild is needed after merge. No vendor/templates touched.
